name: State Trajectory as Composition
description: Theorem: for Z in DSYSTEMS, f in ITZ, x in SZ, and t in TZ+, the state trajectory equals the composition of per-step maps F(s)(y) = NZ(y, f(s)).

elements.text: F(s)(y) = NZ(y, f(s)) for s in IJS[0, t).
F(s) in FNS(SZ, SZ) for every s in IJS[0, t).
STZ(f, x)(t) = (F(t-1) o ... o F(0))(x) for t in TZ+ (with t = 0 base case id).
